title: [LOGGED OUT] Page response has the usual security headers
reason: Strict-Transport-Security is present, but Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy are all missing

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Home page loaded, cookie banner shown

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown, clicked Dismiss (button showing a spinner in the screenshot)

steps.text: Read the response headers of https://site.ludus-game.com/ (for example with fetch in the page).
steps.saw: fetch returned status 200 with headers: cache-control, content-encoding, content-type, date, expires, strict-transport-security, vary, x-geoip-country, x-geoip-region-code, x-guploader-uploadid, x-real-ip, x-request-id

steps.text: Are Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options (or a CSP frame-ancestors rule), X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy headers present?
steps.saw: None of the four were present: no content-security-policy (so no frame-ancestors), no x-frame-options, no x-content-type-options, no referrer-policy. Read via fetch from the page, so headers hidden from JS by CORS rules could not be seen, but these are same-origin and all other headers were visible.
